Perfect! All 125 tests pass. I've successfully created the dates module:

**Changes made:**

✅ **src/dates.js** — New module for UTC date handling:
- `isValidDate(text)`: Validates 'YYYY-MM-DD' format and checks date validity (handles leap years, month boundaries, etc.)
- `addDays(date, n)`: Adds/subtracts n days to a date, working in UTC
- `daysBetween(a, b)`: Calculates whole days between two dates (b - a) in UTC

✅ **src/invoices.js** — Updated to use dates module:
- Imported `isValidDate` from `src/dates.js`
- Removed local `isValidDate` function
- createInvoice now uses the centralized date validation

✅ **test/dates.test.js** — Comprehensive test suite (16 tests):
- Valid date acceptance (including leap year edge cases)
- Invalid format and date rejection
- Adding days (positive, negative, month/year boundaries, leap years)
- Calculating days between dates (positive, negative, leap years)
- Error handling for invalid dates
- UTC consistency verification

**Key design decisions:**
- All dates are `'YYYY-MM-DD'` strings (consistent format)
- All date arithmetic is done in UTC using `T00:00:00Z` to avoid timezone issues
- `daysBetween` uses floor division to get whole days only
- Functions throw descriptive errors on invalid input
- Properly handles leap years (2000, 2024 yes; 1900, 2025 no)
- Centralized date validation used throughout the system

**Key design decisions:**
- All dates are `'YYYY-MM-DD'` strings (consistent format)
- All date arithmetic is done in UTC using `T00:00:00Z` to avoid timezone issues
- `daysBetween` uses floor division to get whole days only
- Functions throw descriptive errors on invalid input
- Properly handles leap years (2000, 2024 yes; 1900, 2025 no)
- Centralized date validation used throughout the system
